import os, sys, json
d = sys.argv[1]
os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
cases = json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
order=[]
for name, body in cases:
    with open(os.path.join(d, name+".in"), "w") as f:
        f.write(body)
    order.append(name)
open(os.path.join(d,"ORDER"),"w").write("\n".join(order)+"\n")
print(len(order),"cases written")
PYEOF
cat > /tmp/probe-c/runall.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: runall.sh <casedir>
cd /tmp/probe-c
d="$1"
while read -r name; do
  [ -z "$name" ] && continue
  /workspace/executable -c "$d/$name.in" > "$d/$name.out" 2> "$d/$name.err"
  echo "$?" > "$d/$name.ec"
done < "$d/ORDER"
echo "done"
EOS
cat > /tmp/probe-c/report.py <<'PYEOF'
import os,sys
d=sys.argv[1]
names=[l.strip() for l in open(os.path.join(d,"ORDER")) if l.strip()]

    out=open(os.path.join(d,n+".out")).read()
    err=open(os.path.join(d,n+".err")).read()
